title: The Rarest Animals on Earth

author: Animalogic
description:
What if a shark alive today was born before the United States even existed? Meet the Greenland Shark, the longest-living vertebrate on Earth. These mysterious deep-sea giants can live for 400+ years, with some estimates suggesting lifespans of over 500 years.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
